source: extends original preview-contract-review proposal; not an adopted runtime design
document_owner: Existing document application owner remains authoritative. Proposed future M03 design/binding representation in WORK and orchestration in HOST/DispatchHost must receive its own exact packet; H1 moves no ownership.
content: Layout, persistent guide/grid/form metadata, declared props/interaction design are content. Their approved mutations advance the document content revision once and are observed by M04/M07 only at completed mutation boundaries.
ephemeral: Selection/focus/playback progress, simulated Viewer control values and navigation are projections. They do not mark document dirty, enter content Undo, advance content revision, or trigger recovery snapshots. Legacy selection/updatedAt wire fields may be preserved for compatibility but are not authority or content-fingerprint input.
Editor: Ordinary click selects a stable-ID item. Explicit authorized property/interaction editing crosses approved application mutation boundary with expected content revision; author-configured behavior is not executed by Editor selection.
Viewer: Explicit mode entry creates detached mock state from an immutable design snapshot. Only allowlisted mock intents; no filesystem/AI/Git/plugin/process/Tauri arbitrary dispatch. Simulated values never write source props or become formal acceptance.
authority_guard: UI-supplied strings do not authenticate owner/session/window. Native application boundary must bind actual sender and current document; M01/S3 context is a dependency, not a second registry created here.

outcomes.StaleRevision: reject intent; retain existing projection with stale badge, no source mutation
outcomes.MissingBinding: disable dependent action and explain missing source/target
outcomes.AmbiguousStableId: do not guess by label or map automatically
outcomes.UnsupportedActionOrScope: visible unsupported state; never fallback to arbitrary execution
outcomes.MissingMaterial: placeholder/warning and disable dependent action, never execute substitute content

refresh_transaction: validate source binding/revision and supported capabilities -> build temporary immutable preview projection -> replace Viewer projection only on success. Failed refresh retains previous projection visibly stale; late completion must be rejected against current binding/revision/session.
cross_location: stable IDs only; mapping missing/duplicate/stale produces explicit result and disables action; imported names do not establish same identity
future_scope: Original M03 proposed design_binding.rs/preview-runtime/UI/Tauri paths remain candidate-only; H2 exact types/command DTOs/owner lifecycle/sequence and capability matrix still require later explicit packet, not authorized by adopting C1 codec recommendations.
